What exactly is running?

Used formal cusoversion 0.4.0, commit fb2747d2105a8e48499bf10a3a717cf80c14d079. This is the execution of the author's algorithms: OptimalShiftPolys and GraphShiftPolys on top of it, with automatic selection of polynomial The old hand-coded lattices were not substituted for them. SEQ-10 not involved in the decision; the old decoder is used only after rooting cuso.

The input was the stored original modular difference cubes module n Known true states, matrices generator and former LLL-Certificates were not transferred to the solver. Exports are verified with stored systems and independent dice disclosure. Strict boundaries API cuso This is clearly stated: integer [a,b] is transmitted as (a−1,b+1), without losing the maximum permissible values.

Wednesday: SageMath 10.9 separately WSL-surroundings assembled from fixed source flatter and msolve. Sources cuso They're preserved intact. In a separate adapter, one remote name call is replaced Sage API is_generator() equivalently is_gen(); the strategies haven't changed. This renaming is described in documentation Sage. Preparatory errors and corrections are reflected in the EXECUTION_NOTE.md.

The main sample was passed 71 staff-test msolve, three author's examples cuso on reduced parameters, border checks and four-dimensional control Both modes with enabled storage of intermediate data. Where there are limitations

  • p5 h16, optimal: after the first strict equation cuso recursively So it solves the augmented system 15 preserved lattice families are made up of coefficients that are multiples of the module It is not possible to have a scaled-up L1-The norm is less than the module.
